root_cause_diagnosis.defect_statement: Abaqus MISESERI is identically zero in the coupled coarse simulation (Job 1421063.mmaster02) because companion standard elements (Layer 3) returned zero stress.
root_cause_diagnosis.why_zero_stress_was_implemented: Layer 3 companion elements (CPE4 and CPE3) connect to the EXACT SAME physical displacement nodes (DOFs 1, 2) as Layer 2 mechanical UEL elements. In Abaqus/Standard, standard continuum elements automatically compute internal forces F_int = integral(B^T * STRESS * dOmega) and stiffness K = integral(B^T * DDSDDE * B * dOmega). If UMAT returned physical stress, Abaqus would add F_int^companion to F_int^UEL at every physical node, creating an internal force doubling F_int^total = 2 * F_int^UEL, which violates Newton-Raphson equilibrium and causes catastrophic solver divergence. Zero stress was therefore intentionally hardcoded to suppress internal force contributions.
root_cause_diagnosis.consequences_for_abaqus_miseseri: Abaqus computes the Zienkiewicz-Zhu Superconvergent Patch Recovery error indicator MISESERI exclusively on standard continuum elements using their integration-point Cauchy stress field S. Abaqus cannot evaluate MISESERI on *USER ELEMENT instances because user elements have no native integration-point stress topology known to the Abaqus solver kernel. Because the companion elements had STRESS = 0 everywhere, Abaqus evaluated sigma_h = 0, smoothed stress sigma* = 0, error e_sigma = 0, and MISESERI = 0 everywhere.

approach_a_direct_uel_umat_forward_trans.name: Approach A: Direct UEL/UMAT Stress Transfer in Forward Solve
approach_a_direct_uel_umat_forward_trans.mechanism: Pass UEL mechanical stress to UMAT via expanded COMMON block. In order to prevent double-counting, suppress Layer 2 UEL mechanical internal force (RHS = 0, AMATRX = 0) and let Layer 3 companion UMAT provide the entire mechanical internal force and tangent stiffness.
blockers_and_risks: Modifies frozen UEL f42_mixed_uel.for, which violates protocol rule #3 and governance boundaries.
Job 1421063.mmaster02 is ALREADY completed; direct forward transfer cannot retroactively fix an existing ODB.
Requires re-running the entire coarse coupled phase-field fracture simulation on HPC.
Staggered coupling latency: UMAT would need to communicate strain energy back to UEL Layer 1 for phase field update.
Abaqus/Standard has NO output-only UMAT call; whatever stress UMAT returns is ALWAYS integrated into equilibrium residual.
approach_a_direct_uel_umat_forward_trans.recommendation: REJECT as primary path for 6-day sprint.

approach_b_non_feedback_replay.name: Approach B: Non-Feedback Replay / Imposed-State Recovery at Terminal Checkpoint
approach_b_non_feedback_replay.mechanism: Separate the fracture equilibrium solve from the stress recovery. Take the authentic converged displacement and phase-field state from Job 1421063.mmaster02 at u_y = 0.00959078 mm. Instantiate a pure standard-continuum model on the exact coarse geometry (preserving notch slit and hole). Evaluate degraded Cauchy stress sigma = ((1-d)^2 + k) * C_0 : epsilon. Compute native Abaqus MISESERI directly from this non-feedback recovery ODB, then run native adaptiveRemesh() to generate the adapted mesh.
advantages: 100% physically noninvasive: does NOT modify the frozen UEL or change the coarse fracture equilibrium.
Preserves authentic donor fracture solution from Job 1421063.mmaster02.
Zero double-counting of stiffness or force (no UEL elements present in the recovery model).
Abaqus natively computes S, MISESAVG, and MISESERI on the standard elements.
Abaqus native RemeshingRule operates directly on the recovery ODB to generate the Method A adapted mesh.
Completely local/offline: zero new PBS submissions required.
approach_b_non_feedback_replay.recommendation: RECOMMENDED as the primary, physically sound Method A recovery mechanism.

approach_c_auxiliary_usdfld_recovery.name: Approach C: Auxiliary USDFLD Recovery (F1659/F1660)
approach_c_auxiliary_usdfld_recovery.mechanism: The established F1659 implementation: uses USDFLD to map donor damage field and evaluate degraded elastic stress on a geometry-backed CAD model.
advantages: Pearson stress correlation r = 0.9575, NRMSE = 4.05% against donor UEL stresses.
Sub-nanometer coordinate alignment (max error = 0.7 nm across 11,452 integration points).
+17.87% force difference fully diagnosed in F1660 (shear/bending stiffness of full-integration CPE4 vs reduced-integration CPS4R).
Native Abaqus RemeshingRule at 5% error target successfully generates a clean 20,213-element crack-path mesh (F1664).
approach_c_auxiliary_usdfld_recovery.recommendation: APPROVED as authoritative reference and immediate operational vehicle.

strategic_selection_and_six_day_roadmap.justification: Mathematical analysis proves that direct UEL/UMAT stress transfer in a forward coupled solve with shared displacement nodes is fundamentally overconstrained: any nonzero stress in UMAT adds to the internal force vector, doubling the internal force and corrupting equilibrium. Non-feedback state recovery (Approaches B/C) is the only mathematically sound, solver-compatible, and frozen-UEL-preserving route to expose authentic Cauchy stresses to Abaqus Superconvergent Patch Recovery without double-counting mechanical forces.
